title: Absolute continuity of Rosenblatt measures
summary: In the article, we address the problem of absolute continuity of translated Rosenblatt measures on the path space. In [Čoupek, P., Kříž, P., Maslowski, B., Stoch. Proc. Appl. 179 (2025) art. no. 104499], it is shown that there is no probability measure that would be equivalent to the original probability measure and under which a Rosenblatt path with a linear drift would again be a Rosenblatt path.
